# TriggerResponse

The result of running an automation by hand.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `processId` | `uuid` | The id of the run its first action started. Each action starts a run of its own; the automation's history lists them all. |

## Example

```json
{
  "processId": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f"
}
```

## Where it's used

- [`automations.trigger`](../api/automations.md) (`POST /automated-actions/by-id/{id}/trigger`)
